latHint: Think holding your ground through hardship - not a cockpit control.
pivHint: A pilot grips the control STICK - but to STICK with something hard means to do what?
winText: Staying the course. STICK was the pivot - cockpit control to STANDing firm.
lossText: STAND - to STICK with it. STICK was the pivot: control STICK to STANDing firm through hardship.
